Name: Jaaziel, Singer
Summary: Levite of the second degree appointed at the bringing up of the ark.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:18: Levite of the second degree appointed at the bringing up of the ark.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jaaziel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
